question: Several sources of GAAP consulted by an auditor are in conflict as to the application of an accounting principle. Which of the following should the auditor consider the most authoritative? A. FASB Technical Bulletins. B. AICPA Accounting Interpretations. C. FASB Statements of Financial Accounting Concepts. D. AICPA Technical Practice Aids.

For an entity's financial statements to be presented fairly in conformity with generally accepted accounting principles, the principles selected should: A. Be applied on a basis consistent with those followed in the prior year. B. Be approved by the Auditing Standards Board or the appropriate industry subcommittee. C. Reflect transactions in a manner that presents the financial statements within a range of acceptable limits. D. Match the principles used by most other entities within the entity's particular industry.
Which of the following categories is included in generally accepted auditing standards? A. Standards of review. B. Standards of planning. C. Standards of fieldwork. D. Standards of evidence.
